title: Plasma Proteomics Identify Biomarkers and Pathogenesis of COVID-19.
summary: It identifies 11 host proteins and specific multi-protein panels associated with severity/outcomes; e.g. a four-protein panel discriminated severity groups and a three-protein combination predicted severe/fatal outcome. Five-fold CV plus a separate proteomics cohort (n=26) and ELISA validation in additional samples. The article notes limited early-pandemic sample sizes and says biomarker mechanisms and therapeutic relevance require further work.
ai_technology: POC-19 uses penalized logistic regression with LASSO/ridge penalties to rank biomarker combinations from plasma proteomics.

The authors used plasma proteomics and their machine-learning POC-19 pipeline (penalized logistic regression with LASSO/ridge) to select protein biomarker combinations for COVID-19 severity/outcome; results were evaluated in a separate plasma cohort and by ELISA in another cohort.
